comment: The proton's row as the two hands declare it (the advisor's (b), #1572 comment 5963954612, the mathematician's 204, 5964082980, two hands; the owner's words of 2026-10-03, 03:26 Israel and 00:52 UTC): the universe file `universe` beside this design, the rule's own rows (gravity, the sign holder `charge` under the plain read at the level weight 1 and the write weight 1, the binding holder) and the row `proton`, the shape by name three planes (`dimension` ["plane", "plane", "plane"], one Wronskian per plane summed into the record's row of the sign), reading gravity 1, binding 1 and the sign holder at matter's weight 1, the pair `pair` [0, 6000]: the frozen proton by the row alone (R_ij = 2 num p^2 Q = 0 on every Link, cos omega_0 = 0, omega_0 = pi / 2, the inertia m* = 3 tan omega_0 infinite, E_rest = T sin omega_0 = T, the ceiling, 1.34 m_e in this universe; the loader admits num = 0, checked tonight); a test row that claims nothing of the proton's mass (in nature's gap-closing universe [den - g_p, den] with g_p = 1836^2 g_e, a declared integer). One body of count 1 at the centre Node `centre` of the open `shape` cube, laid by the generator's one-Node declaration (tools/pixel_mode.py --pixel 0 --sense -1, `pixel_record`: every plane alike at A_l^2 = count T den / (2 sin omega_0 x planes) = T / 6 by the division act's fixed point, 73 at T 32,768, the levels (A, 0) and the sense's (0, -A), equal phases, the sense -1 opposite to the electron's +1 of the shipped charged world), the run `ticks` intervals; one region detector `around` of two Nodes beside the body, whose click lines, if any, would be the body's current into it, and whose field line reads the proton's share over it. The reading (`read_world.py` beside this design): per interval the six lines' levels now, before and remainders at the centre Node (the cycle), the Wronskian sum there, the count in the books, the sign holder's and the binding holder's levels at the centre and its six neighbours, the Nodes carrying a level of the proton (the spread) and the click lines. Every number stands here and the engine reads none; the blind below is the hands', verbatim as the Boss relayed it, written before any lay and never edited after.

amplitude_per_plane.formula: A_l^2 = T / (6 sin omega_0) = T / 6 at [0, 6000]
amplitude_per_plane.value: the fixed point of the division act on 32768 div 6 = 5461: 73

worlds.frozen_proton: the body of count 1 at the centre, laid by the declaration

blind.turn: the levels turn by omega_0 = pi / 2 per interval: the pair (now, before) of every line cycles (A, 0), (0, A), (-A, 0), (0, -A) with the period 4 exactly and the remainder 0, the blind to the bit (R = 0 on every Link, S = 0 at the vacuum paces, Rule3 at the Node reads u = -w a_before + r and a_next = -a_before)
blind.count: the count 1 read (the books' quanta 1 at the start and at every interval)
blind.wronskian: the Wronskian sum over the three planes T / 2 with the proton's sense: -T / 2 = -16,384 at the sense -1 (3 A_l^2 with A_l^2 = T / 6)
blind.rest: the sign holder's rest around the body Poisson's with one unit, the electron's well mirrored (the row the proton owns at its sense, one unit at the Node, falling as the massless kernel beyond)
blind.spread: nothing spreads: at [0, den] the record stays at its one Node, every other Node at 0
blind.click: no click: no credit line and no click line of the proton's current into the region beside it
blind.taker: as a taker only in the conversion's list (+1, the three planes laid at count 1 with the invariant and the sense), since a proton declares no modes; not read in this world
blind.gates: the gate worlds untouched, none declaring the row
